subject: stf
title: STF.------MTH.
description: Diagram in MP(II)-8, first of two on book p490, on the page where Braxton argues that 'the State Department's use of creative music must be viewed as a real factor for political persuasion, yet it must also be understood that at no point has this agency ever had any real understanding of what it was broadcasting' — the music exposed people but the apparatus had no comprehension of what it had created. STF (source transfer) is crossed with MTH (methodology): the question is what source-transfer produces when crossed with methodology when the source-transferring institution doesn't comprehend its own apparatus. ALT-FT (alternative functionalism) branches from the main line just below MTH; TRS (transition) and SCI-DY (scientific dynamics) branch from the ALT-FT line, and IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment) branches from the SCI-DY line. INFO-DY (information dynamics) branches from the main line lower down; ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism) branches from the INFO-DY line, and RT-DY (reality dynamics) from the ACC-FT line. WOR-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle, alternate spelling) drops from the main line near the subject; RE-ST (restructuralism) branches from the WOR-EXP-PRI line, and PER-PHY-U-FUND (perceived physical universe fundamental) and RIT-DY (ritual dynamics) both branch from the RE-ST line.
